properties.name: reflow2.toml's version string moved 0.44.0 -> 0.45.0 for the cut
properties.rationale:
THE DESIGN HOLDS: the design meaning of a cut lives in the Release node and its epoch, not in a version string.

📌 ACCEPTED BEFORE THE MANIFEST IS FROZEN, DELIBERATELY. `release_includes_all` freezes each artifact's CURRENT checksum, so accepting this drift afterwards would make the release record that it shipped the PRE-BUMP file. `flow:release-cut` states this as a forces-resync loop from the manifest step back to here, and says to budget one gate failure and a second export every time the order is got wrong. Recorded on the v0.20.0 cut and it has recurred on every cut since; accepting first is one step instead of two.
properties.subject: record
properties.summary: Version claims moved together for the v0.45.0 cut: Cargo.toml, reflow2.toml, and both of AGENTS.md's shipping-version sentences. Only reflow2.toml is a registered Artifact, so it is the only one that drifts. Nothing it declares about dependencies changed — only the number naming which reflow2 declares them.
